evidence.quote: The sign says, 'Always look on the bright side of life'. It reminds us that kids can reach their dreams with the right help.

facts.text: Maria expressed admiration for John's work, stating that it is inspiring to see how kids can achieve great things with support and encouraging him to keep up the good work.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Maria! It means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing for them. We need folks in the community, doing good for the ones who need it. We rock!
